notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 5
notes.content:
We're happy to announce the release of the 5th Update for S.H.E.L.T.E.R.

This will update the game to Version 0.34. 

This is the pre-last update of the game. 

The Full release is planned for November with epilogues to the main story.

Changelog:

[list]
[*] You can now impregnate Lucy and have a child with her as well as pregnant scenes.

[*] You can now impregnate Mandisa and have a child with her as well as pregnant scenes.

[*] You can now corrupt Mandisa.
[/list]

We hope you will enjoy this update and stay tuned.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 2
notes.content:
We are happy to introduce the second major update for S.H.E.L.T.E.R. which will update the game to version 0.28.

Changelog:
[list]
[*] You can now plan second operation in the armory and get another upgrade for settlement’s defense.

[*] You can also scavenge the military base for supply

[*] Android can now create a baby (romance route only) and get a job in the settlement.

[*] Lucy can now be completely cured or only get her voice back (depending on your previous choice).

[*] New outfit for Melisa that comes with 3 new sex scenes.

[*] The Bandit Leader will now visit you a week after your second encounter and you can choose to get to know her better.

[*] New sex scenes with Android, Lucy, Bandit Leader, Melisa, Mandisa and a scene with Angela, Kira and    Melisa if you are on their harem romance route. [b]13 new sex scenes overall[/b].

[*] Fixed various typos and issues with the gallery.

[/list]

The [b]next update[/b] is scheduled to release in [b]May[/b].

We hope you enjoy this update. If you encounter any bugs or problems, please let us know and we will fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Update 1
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience and support, we are happy to announce the release of the first major update of S.H.E.L.T.E.R. which will update the game to version 0.26.

This update will introduce new content to the routes and to the main story, which will setup events in the future.


Changelog:

[list]
[*] Pregnancy content for Tiffany, Jay and Elin.
[*] You can now decide who has the right to own weapons in the settlement and upgrade armory.
[*] Continuation of Grace’s and Lucy’s story. New sex scenes with Tiffany, Jay, Elin, Mandisa, Grace, Mia, Lucy and Bandit Leader. [b]19 New sex scenes overall.[/b]
[*] The Bandit Leader will now visit you after a week since your first encounter[spoiler]where you might reach the first bad ending of the game depending on your choice.[/spoiler] 
[*] Steam Cloud to store your save files.
[*] New music tracks were added.
[/list]

[b]The approximate date for the next release will be at the end of March.[/b]


We hope you enjoy this update. If you encounter any bugs or problems, please let us know and we will fix them as soon as possible.

notes.title: S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Hotfix 0.22a
notes.content:
We have gathered some feedback and decided to release a hotfix that should help with some issues, that were encountered, thank you for your continuous support and ideas. 
We are looking forward to improving S.H.E.L.T.E.R. as much as possible!


[u][b]S.H.E.L.T.E.R. Hotfix 0.22a

[/b][/u][b]Changelog[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed reported typos, errors and graphical bugs.
[*] Adjusted some scenes to keep the story consistent.
[*] Moved the counter of the cans into the button for better visibility in darker backgrounds.
[*] Added the option to change the opacity of the textbox in the preference slider, but it will also apply itself at the start of scenes.
[*] Added the option to make Oscar, Kira, Angela and Melisa your friends instead of your family in the preference screen as well as on the first start up. 
[/list]
[b]To change relationships mid game: [/b]
[olist]
[*] 	Load the save you want to change.
[*] 	Open the Preference Menu (Right click or navigation bar).
[*] 	Choose if you want to have Incest On or Off.
[*] 	Press Apply.
[/olist]
[b]Important[/b]: Do not rollback after you pressed apply, else you might have to restart the process.
